title: CHGR Governance Record Lifecycle Event
description: Artifact classification: Evidentiary. One append-only state transition record for a HumanGovernanceRecord (CHGR-001 Sec.13). No transition command exists this increment (Phase 143E) -- this schema exists so the eight-state model and its linked evidence can be structurally represented and tested without enabling any lifecycle operation. A structurally valid event never proves the initiating_actor was eligible to cause it (CHGR-001 Sec.11); eligibility is a template-level, verification-time concern.

record_id.description: This event's own identity -- a distinct identifier space from governed_record_id below; an event never overwrites or reuses the governed record's own identity.

initiating_actor.description: Identity evidence for who caused this transition, at its actual assurance level. Whether this actor was eligible under the governed record's own template is a verification-time, never a schema-time, determination.

evidence_ref.description: Reference to the linked governance act or evidence justifying this transition (CHGR-001 Sec.13's 'new, linked CHGR' requirement for suspend/supersede/revoke).

linked_record_id.description: Optional. For a supersession event, the new record that supersedes governed_record_id.

extensions.description: Controlled additive extension container. Empty object permitted.
